mapper.sql: operation_id, tenant_id, hotel_id, caller_namespace, command_name, idempotency_key, hash_version, request_hash, status, result_code, result_ref, response_snapshot, created_at, completed_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotency_record (operation_id, tenant_id, hotel_id, caller_namespace, command_name, idempotency_key, hash_version, request_hash, status, result_code, result_ref, response_snapshot, created_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{operationId}, #{tenantId}, #{hotelId}, #{callerNamespace}, #{commandName}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{hashVersion}, #{requestHash}, #{status}, #{resultCode}, #{resultRef}, #{responseSnapshot}::jsonb, now(), #{completedAt}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO idempotency_record (operation_id, tenant_id, hotel_id, caller_namespace, command_name, idempotency_key, hash_version, request_hash, status, result_code, result_ref, response_snapshot, created_at, completed_at) VALUES (#{operationId}, #{tenantId}, #{hotelId}, #{callerNamespace}, #{commandName}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{hashVersion}, #{requestHash}, #{status}, #{resultCode}, #{resultRef}, #{responseSnapshot}::jsonb, #{createdAt}, #{completedAt}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE idempotency_record SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', result_ref = #{resultRef}, response_snapshot = #{responseSnapshot}::jsonb, completed_at = #{at} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND operation_id = #{operationId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
UPDATE idempotency_record SET status = 'FAILED', result_code = #{resultCode}, completed_at = #{at} WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND operation_id = #{operationId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
